title: Brazilian Portuguese Translator
description:
About us


Bitget is one of the world’s leading digital assets ecosystems. With over 120 million registered users, Bitget has one of the most comprehensive suites of blockchain products and services available via bitget.com.


Our mission is to support the growth of the digital assets industry and we believe it represents the future of finance. What we do empowers the future of finance by ensuring secure, efficient and smart digital transactions.


We are one of the fastest growing companies in the digital asset sector. If you are looking for cutting-edge work, where you will have opportunities to develop your career among peers who are experts in their field, and you believe in the future of crypto currency, then look no further than Bitget!


What you'll do


  • Translate corporate documents into Brazilian Portuguese with accuracy and cultural relevance.
  • Proofread and edit content to ensure consistency, grammar, and style.
  • Apply internal glossaries and style guides for terminology consistency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on context and objectives.
  • Manage multiple translation projects under tight deadlines.
  • Use CAT tools effectively to support translation workflow.
  • Safeguard sensitive and confidential information.
  • Participate in linguistic quality assurance reviews.
  • Stay current with industry language trends, especially in crypto.


What you'll need


  • Bachelor’s degree in Translation, Linguistics, or related field (or currently pursuing).
  • Proven translation experience, ideally in corporate or crypto-related settings.
  • Fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Solid understanding of grammar, syntax, and cultural nuances.
  • Proficiency in CAT tools.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • High professionalism in handling confidential content.


Why Bitget?


  • Bitget is the world's leading web 3 platform for copy trading and one of the world's largest and most respected exchanges
  • We are a global company with staff members from over 50 different countries and regions
  • We are growing and looking for world-class ambitious talents to help us continue this journey
  • We have a streamlined structure that empowers employees to work efficiently, delivering the best results in a short timeframe
  • We offer competitive salaries and benefits
  • Blockchain technology and digital assets have the potential to change finance in a way no other technology can - be part of it!



If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!

title: [Fully Remote] Design Engineer (React, TypeScript)
description:
About Oleve

Oleve builds and manages a suite of mobile and web products that power experiences for millions of users worldwide. We combine thoughtful design, strong engineering, and data-driven iteration to create software that is fast, beautiful, and reliable. Our tech stack spans Next.js , React Native , and Python , allowing us to deliver consistent experiences across devices with shared components and a unified design system.

Role & Purpose

As a Design Engineer  at Oleve, you’ll sit at the intersection of design and front-end engineering — crafting visually stunning, high-performing, and accessible user interfaces. You’ll bring our brand and products to life through motion, interactivity, and thoughtful systems that scale across our ecosystem.

You’ll collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers to implement creative, performant solutions for both web and mobile. This role blends design thinking with technical rigor — ideal for someone who loves to code and cares deeply about visual polish and user experience.

What You’ll Do
  • Partner with design, product, and engineering teams to ship world-class interfaces across Oleve’s web and mobile products.
  • Build and maintain our shared design system  in React and React Native, ensuring a cohesive visual language and UX across all products.
  • Translate complex design concepts into responsive, performant components using Next.js  and React Native .
  • Lead and contribute to front-end architecture discussions, focusing on accessibility, Core Web Vitals, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to design efficient API integrations and end-to-end user flows.
  • Mentor other engineers on UI craft, motion design, and design systems best practices.
  • Experiment with new technologies, animation techniques, and tools that enhance design-to-code workflows.
  • Work closely with marketing and growth teams to deliver fast, scalable, and visually refined campaigns or landing pages.
About You
  • You have 3+ years  of experience in front-end or design engineering roles, ideally within product-focused teams.
  • You’re fluent in React , Next.js , React Native , TypeScript , and have a working knowledge of Python  or backend APIs.
  • You’re comfortable in Figma  and can collaborate effectively with designers from concept to launch.
  • You have an eye for detail — typography, spacing, motion, and interactivity all matter to you.
  • You understand performance, accessibility, and SEO, and know how to balance technical trade-offs.
  • You’ve worked in a multi-product  environment and can build systems that scale across multiple apps.
  • You’re comfortable working with analytics  (Mixpanel, Amplitude) and using data to guide design and UX decisions.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments and can comfortably move between creative and technical conversations.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
description:
Seniority : Lead

Location : Remote (LATAM preferred)

Contract Type : Full-time Contractor

Start Date : Early to mid-November 2025

Duration : 6 months (with the possibility of extension)

Schedule : Must be available between 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM EST


We’re looking for a Lead Fullstack Engineer to take technical ownership of two web-based products currently in development. This is a hands-on leadership role that blends architecture, coding, and collaboration. You’ll guide the project's direction, make key technical decisions, and ensure the delivery of reliable, scalable, and well-built software.


We’re looking for someone proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working directly with product and design teams. You’ll be part of a small, talented group focused on building high-quality tools that make a real impact.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design, implementation, and delivery of multiple web applications.
  • Work closely with product and design to turn requirements into well-structured, maintainable solutions.
  • Write clean, high-quality code using Node.js, React, and TypeScript.
  • Design and optimize databases using PostgreSQL.
  • Build and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure using AWS (ECS, EKS, S3, RDS).
  • Manage integrations with external platforms, including SSO and Okta.
  • Ensure performance, reliability, and security best practices are applied throughout the stack.
  • Support and mentor other developers, helping improve processes and code quality.


Requirements

  • Strong experience with Node.js, React, and TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL.
  • Proven experience deploying and maintaining applications on AWS (ECS, EKS, S3, RDS).
  • Comfortable with serverless architectures and microservices.
  • Experience integrating third-party tools and identity providers (SSO, Okta, etc.).
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make thoughtful technical decisions.
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have

  • Experience in the education technology sector or other large-scale, user-facing platforms.
  • Familiarity with Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Prior experience as a Tech Lead or Engineering Manager.
  • Strong eye for quality, UX, and performance.


Why Join

  • Lead the technical direction of growing products from an early stage.
  • Work in a fast-paced, fully remote environment with a high level of autonomy.
  • Collaborate with a passionate and professional team.

  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL.
  • Proven experience deploying and maintaining applications on AWS (ECS, EKS, S3, RDS).

  • Experience integrating third-party tools and identity providers (SSO, Okta, etc.).

  • Familiarity with Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Prior experience as a Tech Lead or Engineering Manager.
  • Strong eye for quality, UX, and performance.


Why Join

  • Lead the technical direction of growing products from an early stage.

title: Network Operations Analyst (L1/L2 NOC – Early Shift) - LATAM
description:
SONDA is the largest IT service provider in Latin America, leader in systems integration, support and IT outsourcing. With almost 50 years of experience and in constant growth around the World, and growing so far in in US, as well.


We are looking for a Network Operations Analyst to join our client’s Early Shift team, providing first-line monitoring and coordination of network incidents across multiple retail locations. This professional will act as the main communication point between the client and the Managed Service Provider (MSP), ensuring timely updates, incident tracking, and clear communication with internal stakeholders.


Location: Nearshore (LATAM)

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, from 5:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET

Model: Remote


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor network events and incidents, escalating as needed (L1/L2 NOC equivalent).
  • Coordinate with the Managed Service Provider for updates and resolution progress.
  • Communicate incident status, impact, and resolution details to the Early Shift team.
  • Track, document, and report network incidents following established SLAs and procedures.
  • Support escalation and root cause analysis processes when required.
  • Maintain up-to-date records of communication, incident logs, and service documentation.


Requirements

  • Experience in Network Operations , NOC , or related technical support roles.
  • Basic understanding of network infrastructure (LAN/WAN, routers, switches, connectivity).
  • Familiarity with incident management and ticketing systems .
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent organizational and coordination abilities.
  • Availability to work from 5:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET (early shift).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in retail network environments or with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) .
  • Exposure to network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Zabbix, Nagios, PRTG).
  • Basic certifications such as CompTIA Network+ or CCNA are a plus.

title: US Immigration Law Firm Paralegal / Brazilian Attorney (Remote)
description:
About Colombo & Hurd, PL


Colombo & Hurd, PL is a nationally recognized boutique immigration law firm dedicated to representing professionals, investors, businesses, and families from across Latin America and around the world. Since our founding in 2006, we’ve grown to a global team of over 350, including more than 30 U.S.-based immigration attorneys.


Named the Top Immigration Law Firm in Central Florida by the Orlando Business Journal, we take pride in our mission to provide exceptional legal representation while advancing the cause of immigrants. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and integrity defines who we are.


Position Overview:


We are looking for a licensed attorney in Brazil to join our team, and work closely with U.S.-based attorneys, as well as our paralegals in South America and the U.S., to manage complex U.S. immigration cases. Your expertise will be instrumental in guiding high potential individuals and businesses through the intricate U.S. immigration landscape. A successful candidate will have excellent writing, research and analytical skills to assume responsibility in an active and diverse immigration practice. The applicant must be fully bilingual in both English and Portuguese.


This role requires excellent communication skills both via email and orally. It is exceptionally important that we communicate with our clients in both a timely and effective manner.


Our workforce uses their own devices, ensuring flexibility in how our team operates remotely. A stable internet connection with a speed of over 25 Mbps is required.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Strategic Case Analysis: Dive deep into complex EB-2 National Interest Waiver and EB-1 Immigrant Visa cases, identifying opportunities and potential challenges.
  • Meticulous Legal Research: Conduct in-depth legal research to ensure compliance with U.S. immigration laws and regulations.
  • Persuasive Legal Writing: Craft compelling legal documents, including petitions, briefs, and memorandums, to advocate for your clients' interests.
  • Client Collaboration: Build strong relationships with clients, providing clear and concise information and solicitation of documentation throughout the immigration process.
  • Global Teamwork: Collaborate seamlessly with a diverse team of legal professionals across the globe to achieve optimal outcomes.


Qualifications:


  • Licensed Lawyer in Brazil
  • 3+ years of legal experience (preferred, not required)
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong research and analytical abilities
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • A passion for immigration law and a desire to make a positive impact


Application process:


  • (Colombo & Hurd:) Resume review
  • Request for Brief Video Introduction
  • Interview with Colombo & Hurd Team
  • (Colombo & Hurd:) Offer


Job Type: Fully Remote full-time position - standard business hours.


Join our Dynamic Team:


As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge cases, collaborate with top legal minds, and make a significant impact on the lives of our clients.


We seek professionals who embody our core values of Integrity, Excellence, Teamwork, Hard Work, and Open Communication.


Ready to Make Your Mark?


If you're a motivated and talented attorney seeking a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

title: Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris)
description:
Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris)

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior / Especialista


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris) experiente para atuar na definição e sustentação da arquitetura de soluções de e-commerce em ambiente SAP. O profissional será responsável por garantir o desempenho, escalabilidade e integração do SAP Commerce com demais sistemas corporativos, além de apoiar o time técnico em decisões de arquitetura e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

O papel requer forte base técnica, visão estratégica e experiência consolidada em projetos complexos de SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris , atuando de forma colaborativa com equipes de desenvolvimento, negócio e infraestrutura.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura técnica e funcional das soluções baseadas em SAP Commerce (Hybris).
  • Garantir a integração eficiente do Commerce com SAP ERP / S/4HANA , SAP CPI e demais sistemas legados.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de código, performance e segurança .
  • Conduzir análises de impacto, revisões técnicas e troubleshooting de alto nível.
  • Definir estratégias de deploy, versionamento e ambientes de homologação/produção .
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais, apoiando o time de produto e negócios em decisões arquiteturais.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, orientando desenvolvedores e garantindo a aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto ou Desenvolvedor Sênior SAP Commerce (Hybris) .
  • Sólido domínio em Java, Spring Framework e arquitetura RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) e/ou ambientes On-Premise.
  • Conhecimento em integrações com SAP ERP ou SAP S/4HANA , utilizando SAP CPI ou APIs customizadas.
  • Experiência em projetos de e-commerce B2B e B2C .
  • Vivência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git), automação (Jenkins, SonarQube) e metodologias ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com microservices , API management e arquiteturas em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) .
  • Certificação SAP Commerce ou SAP Certified Development Professional – SAP Commerce Cloud.

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.

title: Regional Workforce Administration Manager
description:
Regional Workforce Administration Manager

Employment Type: Full Time Location: Brazil

Remote

Job Summary

Iron Mountain is seeking an experienced, strategic Regional Workforce Administration Manager to join our Workforce Administration (WFA) team. This person needs to be familiar with I-9 (Employment eligibility verification) and US Workforce processes asides from local Workforce Administration.

The ideal candidate must be strong in deploying inhouse strategies regarding employee files, benefit administration among others.

You will be leading and optimizing the delivery of retained Workforce Administration services across a multi-country region, ensuring compliance, data accuracy, and a high-quality employee experience.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Lead a regional team of 4 to 10 Workforce Administration professionals, providing coaching, managing performance, and fostering continuous professional development.
  • Oversee all retained WFA services and, for regions outside of North America (NAM), manage Benefits Administration to ensure processes are properly documented, executed, and compliant with all local government regulations.
  • Drive continuous service delivery improvement by identifying opportunities, implementing solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy, and collaborating with regional leaders on transformative projects (e.g., migrating administration work from other HR teams).

What You'll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 7+ years of proven experience in HR operations, HR Shared Services, or Workforce Administration, with a strong focus on a multi-country or international environment.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management, including leading, coaching, and managing the performance of direct reports.
  • In-depth knowledge of HR compliance requirements, employee data reporting, and Benefits Administration principles across Latam and North America.
  • Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish , along with demonstrated experience using HRIS systems like Workday and case management tools like ServiceNow (although others similar are ok)

What We Offer (Benefits)

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Flexible work options/alternative work options to support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

If you are a proven HR leader with deep expertise in workforce administration and a passion for driving operational excellence across diverse regions, apply to join Iron Mountain and lead our team today!

  • Oversee all retained WFA services and, for regions outside of North America (NAM), manage Benefits Administration to ensure processes are properly documented, executed, and compliant with all local government regulations.
  • Drive continuous service delivery improvement by identifying opportunities, implementing solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy, and collaborating with regional leaders on transformative projects (e.g., migrating administration work from other HR teams).

What You'll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 7+ years of proven experience in HR operations, HR Shared Services, or Workforce Administration, with a strong focus on a multi-country or international environment.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management, including leading, coaching, and managing the performance of direct reports.
  • In-depth knowledge of HR compliance requirements, employee data reporting, and Benefits Administration principles across Latam and North America.
  • Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish , along with demonstrated experience using HRIS systems like Workday and case management tools like ServiceNow (although others similar are ok)

What We Offer (Benefits)

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Flexible work options/alternative work options to support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

If you are a proven HR leader with deep expertise in workforce administration and a passion for driving operational excellence across diverse regions, apply to join Iron Mountain and lead our team today!

title: Full Cycle Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Cycle Engineer with a strong command of React Native, Node.js

with NestJS, and DevOps practices, especially AWS and Terraform. This role is perfect for someone

who thrives in a startup environment and enjoys owning the full development lifecycle, from planning and coding to deployment and monitoring. Familiarity with .NET and Angular is a plus, but not required at an advanced level.


Key Responsibilities:

- Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using React Native and NestJS.

- Implement and manage cloud infrastructure using AWS services and Terraform.

- Build and deploy containerized applications with Docker.

- Collaborate across the full development cycle, from architecture and design to CI/CD and release

management.

- Participate in code reviews, ensure best practices, and optimize for performance and reliability.

- Stay up to date with emerging technologies and contribute innovative ideas to improve systems and processes.


Core Requirements:

- Strong proficiency in React Native and NestJS.

- Hands-on experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, ECS, or similar).

- Practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code.

- Solid understanding of Docker for containerization.

- Familiarity with .NET and Angular (basic to intermediate).

- Good understanding of cloud computing principles and CI/CD pipelines.


Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with Kubernetes or other orchestration tools.

- Prior experience in full-cycle roles, especially within small startup teams.

- Knowledge of MSSQL and PostgreSQL databases.

- Exposure to Python, Machine Learning, or AI-driven systems.

- Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly and learn new technologies.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Developer with extensive ITOM experience to lead the development and enhancement of our ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in CMDB, Discovery, Integrations, and related ITOM modules. Must be able to work in fast-paced environment, often requiring collaboration with various teams and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement complex ServiceNow ITOM solutions including CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping.
  • Experience with configuring and customizing ServiceNow applications and modules.
  • Lead development of integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance.
  • Ensure best practices in coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Provide solutions that utilize most out of the box features without requiring customizations. Facilitate the reuse of code, components, and proven patterns; Influence common modeling, design, and coding practices.
  • Perform upgrade testing by validating customizations, configurations, and integrations across major and minor ServiceNow releases.
  • Develop and maintain Automated Test Framework (ATF) test suites to validate core ServiceNow functionalities, ensuring stability and reducing manual regression efforts.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues.
  • Maintain documentation for development and configuration.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 5-7 years of ServiceNow development experience with a focus on ITOM.
  • Strong knowledge of CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and Integrations.
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Glide API, REST/SOAP integrations, and ServiceNow scripting.
  • Experience with automation and DevOps practices, familiarity with continuous integration (CI/CD), code versioning tools such as Git, and Agile principles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to establish strong relationships internally and externally.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Experience with AI, Virtual Agent, Robot Process Automation (RPA)



this position pays $25/hr USD

title: ServiceNow SPM Sr. Consultant / Functional Lead
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Conduzir a análise técnica do ambiente ServiceNow SPM , revisando arquitetura, integrações e fluxos de dados.

— Avaliar desempenho, segurança e aderência às boas práticas da plataforma, garantindo escalabilidade e sustentabilidade da solução.

— Mapear pontos de integração e revisar a escalabilidade técnica do ambiente.

— Identificar customizações existentes e avaliar o grau de aderência às funcionalidades nativas do ServiceNow.

— Avaliar prontidão para upgrade , riscos de compatibilidade e oportunidades de otimização.

— Recomendar ajustes técnicos, refactoring ou rollback quando necessário.

— Elaborar diagramas arquiteturais e documentação técnica detalhada.

— Apoiar o desenho de roadmaps técnicos e estratégias de melhoria contínua.

O que você precisa ter

— Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência com ServiceNow , incluindo participação em pelo menos 3 projetos SPM .

— Forte domínio técnico em arquitetura, integrações, performance e segurança .

— Experiência prática com CSDM, Flow Designer, Integration Hub e Performance Analytics .

— Certificação SPM-CIS fortemente desejável.

— CTA (Certified Technical Architect) ou CMA (Certified Master Architect) são diferenciais relevantes.

— Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em inglês e português.;

— Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: ServiceNow SPM Sr. Consultant / Functional Lead
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

— Conduzir a análise técnica do ambiente ServiceNow SPM , revisando arquitetura, integrações e fluxos de dados.

— Mapear pontos de integração e revisar a escalabilidade técnica do ambiente.

— Identificar customizações existentes e avaliar o grau de aderência às funcionalidades nativas do ServiceNow.

— Avaliar prontidão para upgrade , riscos de compatibilidade e oportunidades de otimização.

— Recomendar ajustes técnicos, refactoring ou rollback quando necessário.

— Elaborar diagramas arquiteturais e documentação técnica detalhada.

— Apoiar o desenho de roadmaps técnicos e estratégias de melhoria contínua.

— Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência com ServiceNow , incluindo participação em pelo menos 3 projetos SPM .

title: Electrical BIM Specialist
description:
Now Hiring: Electrical BIM Specialist

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Engagement Type: Full-Time

Work Format: Work From Home


Note: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume in English.


At Eracore , we bring innovation and precision to the forefront of electrical construction through advanced BIM modeling. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Backed by a dynamic team of 40+ talented modelers and engineers, Eracore is more than just a workplace its a launchpad for ambitious professionals. We collaborate with top-tier electrical contractors nationwide, offering unparalleled exposure, hands-on experience, and real opportunities for career advancement.


If you're ready to work on game-changing projects, grow alongside a fast-rising company, and be part of shaping the future of electrical construction, Eracore is where your next chapter begins.


Join us and shape the future of the construction industry!


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a BIM/VDC Specialist at Eracore . The Electrical BIM Modeler will be responsible for creating 3D models and shop drawings to provide clarity and precision during field installations. The role involves utilizing BIM software for visualization and validation of electrical installations.


Qualifications

  • 3-4 Years of Experience with Revit
  • Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Construction Drawings skills
  • Experience with Prefabrication Spool Drawings
  • Experience in working with Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems
  • Proficiency in Architecture and Modeler software
  • Knowledge of electrical design principles and calculations
  • Ability to interpret and create single line diagrams
  • Experience in load calculations and voltage drop evaluations
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

title: Tech Lead | Engenheiro de IA (LLM)
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

title: DevOps Engineer - AWS
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer (AWS Specialist)

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: $4000-6,000 per month (Depending on experience)


IF APPLYING, SEND CV IN ENGLISH


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and motivated DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and a solid background in Windows-based infrastructure .

As a member of our global DevOps and infrastructure team, you will be involved in designing, building, and maintaining modern cloud platforms and automation pipelines that support our mission-critical systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and other Infrastructure as Code tools.
  • Support and manage Windows-based systems including Active Directory , domain configuration , and Entra ID .
  • Implement security controls, tools, and processes aligned with best practices in cloud and infrastructure security .
  • Provide support across Windows systems as required (Linux knowledge is a plus).
  • Manage and scale containerized applications using Kubernetes .
  • Set up and manage monitoring and alerting with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana .
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable and secure infrastructure solutions.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and automation workflows.


Key Requirements

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience working with AWS in production environments.
  • Strong Windows Server experience, including Active Directory , domain setup , and Entra ID .
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure security best practices .
  • Practical experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code methodologies.
  • Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Expereince with Ansible
  • Familiarity with monitoring/observability using Grafana , Prometheus , or similar.
  • Fluent English communication skills .
  • Must be permanently based in Ireland and eligible to work without sponsorship.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with Linux system administration.
  • Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python).


What We Offer

  • Fully remote role , but you must reside in Brazil
  • Permanent employment with long-term project engagement and career progression.
  • Dynamic, international team working on cutting-edge cloud and DevOps technologies.
  • Opportunities for professional development and training.

title: Cloud Native Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Cloud Native Developer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the role:


As a Senior Cloud Native Developer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, cloud-native applications using Azure and .NET technologies . You will collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality software solutions that follow modern engineering practices.

This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Azure cloud services , microservices , and backend development , combined with strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native applications using Azure services , .NET Core , and C# .
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to ensure smooth and automated deployments.
  • Define and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Pulumi .
  • Develop microservices and event-driven architectures leveraging Azure Functions , Azure Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs , ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, QA, and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Apply best practices for monitoring , logging , and application performance management .
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience in software development with .NET Core and C# .
  • Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services , including Azure Functions , Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts , including hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi , Terraform , or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing containers (Docker) and working with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of software design principles , clean code , and best engineering practices .
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work collaboratively in distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with Application Insights , Grafana , or other monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of MuleSoft or similar integration platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Skip 

Skip helps millions of entrepreneurs and small business owners access funding, build their businesses, and grow faster — all in one place. Skip's revenue is comparable to high growth Series B companies and has doubled it's MRR in the past 2 months. Over 1 million business owners trust Skip to simplify what used to be a maze of red tape. Now, we’re building the next evolution of entrepreneurship lead by AI tools and experiences — an AI cofounder for the world's entrepreneurs


Your Role 

Ownership. As a lead engineer on our AI & product team, you’ll ship new AI-powered tools that give entrepreneurs real leverage — from conversational business plan builders to RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) systems that personalize the experience for each business owner. You’ll work closely with the founder, product, and design to bring ideas from prototype to production and directly impact millions of business owners.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and ship new AI features using OpenAI APIs, vector embeddings, and smart chat flows.
  • Develop and refine systems that combine user data, business context, and public funding info to make every AI interaction feel personalized.
  • Contribute to Skip’s entire product stack: React/Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, and Supabase.
  • Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate — we move fast and get real features in real users’ hands.
  • Work as a forward-deployed engineer: collaborating directly with product, design, and customer feedback to find what works.


About You

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience — ideally with some AI, LLM, or RAG experience.
  • Comfortable with TypeScript, React/Next.js, and building consumer or SMB-facing applications.
  • Excited to solve real problems for real entrepreneurs — not just build features in a vacuum.
  • Confident communicator in English, able to work closely with a remote team in the Americas time zone.
  • You care about impact: you want your work to empower millions of people to build and grow.


Why This Role?

  • You’ll be one of the core engineers shaping Skip’s AI Cofounder — a new way to help entrepreneurs skip the red tape and succeed.
  • You'll be joining an inspiring and motivated team including an existing Brazil team
  • You’ll have major product and technical ownership, not just tickets.
  • You’ll see your work help real businesses every day — from side hustlers to growing teams.


Compensation

  • Base Salary: $60,000–$80,000 USD equivalent (paid in USD or BRL)
  • Equity: 0.10%–0.40% — meaningful, because you’re building Skip’s future.
  • Plus: paid time off, remote work, and the chance to grow with a company that’s taking off.


Interested? Send us your portfolio, GitHub, and what excites you about the Skip mission to


We’re ready to build the future of entrepreneurship — and we want you on the team.

title: Especialista de Tecnologia – Dados & Analytics
description:
Será responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar processos de coleta, tratamento e análise de grandes volumes de dados, transformando informações em insights estratégicos que apoiem a tomada de decisão em todas as áreas da empresa. Atuará com ferramentas de Data Warehousing, Data Factory e Power BI, assegurando a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados corporativos, além de acompanhar tendências como o Microsoft Fabric.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a coleta, transformação e integração de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de ETL e pipelines de dados;
  • Estruturar e manter ambientes de dados (Data Lake, Data Warehouse) garantindo desempenho, governança e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar conjuntos de dados e modelos analíticos para relatórios e dashboards interativos no Power BI;
  • Aplicar técnicas de análise avançada, modelagem estatística e machine learning para geração de insights preditivos e prescritivos;
  • Garantir a governança, qualidade e segurança das informações, assegurando conformidade com normas e legislações como LGPD e GDPR;
  • Automatizar processos de integração e análise de dados, promovendo eficiência e inovação contínua;
  • Colaborar com equipes de negócio e tecnologia para identificar oportunidades de uso estratégico dos dados e apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital.


Requisitos e Certificações:

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia e análise de dados, com domínio de Power BI, Azure Data Factory e Data Warehousing;
  • Certificações Microsoft DP-900 (Fundamentos de Dados) e DP-700 (Power BI) são altamente desejáveis;
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em Microsoft Fabric será considerado um diferencial estratégico;
  • Certificação DP-203 (Data Engineering on Azure) é um diferencial para compreender e evoluir pipelines legados.

title: Especialista de Tecnologia – Dados & Analytics
description:
Será responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar processos de coleta, tratamento e análise de grandes volumes de dados, transformando informações em insights estratégicos que apoiem a tomada de decisão em todas as áreas da empresa. Atuará com ferramentas de Data Warehousing, Data Factory e Power BI, assegurando a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados corporativos, além de acompanhar tendências como o Microsoft Fabric.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a coleta, transformação e integração de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de ETL e pipelines de dados;
  • Estruturar e manter ambientes de dados (Data Lake, Data Warehouse) garantindo desempenho, governança e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar conjuntos de dados e modelos analíticos para relatórios e dashboards interativos no Power BI;

title: Arquiteto de Soluções- Oracle
description:
Resumo

Profissional responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir soluções de integração e middleware, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura. Atua como referência técnica em plataformas SOA / OAG (Oracle API Gateway, Oracle SOA Suite) e em arquiteturas serverless com AWS Lambda, alinhando integrações legadas a soluções modernas em nuvem.

Principais Responsabilidades

Definir e manter a arquitetura de middleware (on-premises e cloud), suportando integrações críticas entre sistemas, parceiros e APIs externas.

Projetar soluções com OAG e Oracle SOA Suite, assegurando governança, segurança e políticas de API.

Liderar a migração e/ou modernização de integrações para AWS Lambda e outros serviços nativos da AWS (API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions).

Atuar na definição de padrões de integração, protocolos (REST, SOAP, JMS, eventos) e estratégias de mensageria.

Estabelecer guidelines de observabilidade e monitoramento (Dynatrace, CloudWatch, ELK).

Garantir alta disponibilidade e performance em integrações de missão crítica.

Apoiar squads e times de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de middleware e nuvem.

Conduzir avaliações de impacto técnico e provas de conceito (POCs) em novas tecnologias de integração.

Requisitos Técnicos

Middleware / SOA

Experiência com Oracle SOA Suite (BPEL, OSB, Mediator, Adapters).

Conhecimento profundo em Oracle API Gateway (OAG) e gestão de políticas de segurança (OAuth, JWT, rate limiting, throttling).

Integração via SOAP, REST, JMS, MQ, FTP, DB adapters.

Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.

Cloud (AWS)

Experiência em AWS Lambda e arquiteturas serverless.

Integração com API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions.

Conhecimentos em IAM (Identity and Access Management) e segurança em nuvem.

Monitoramento com CloudWatch e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Arquitetura

Definição de roadmaps de modernização para integrações legadas.

Aplicação de padrões de integração (EAI, ESB, event-driven).

Conhecimento em arquitetura de APIs (API-first, design RESTful, OpenAPI/Swagger).

Experiência em middleware híbrido (on-premises + cloud).

Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.

Desejável

Experiência com Kong, Apigee ou outros API Gateways.

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes, OKE, EKS).

Certificações Oracle ou AWS (ex: AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional).

Experiência em projetos com migração para nuvem.

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Estamos contratando SDR - Homeoffice


Você é um SDR focado em gerar mais resultados…. essa vaga é pra você!

Não quero saber do seu currículo, nem quero saber do seu diploma, eu quero a sua responsabilidade e lealdade para executar o processo. 


Tipo de Contrato: PJ

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Buscamos por pessoas obstinadas em superar as metas e com um bom histórico.

O candidato ideal compartilhará nossos valores de honestidade, transparência e compromisso com a satisfação do cliente.

Excelente estrutura salarial e de comissões sobre as metas.

Se você não tem disposição e coração ensinável para aprender, nem preencha. 


Cargo: SDR


Principais responsabilidades da função:

Conduzir reuniões e calls com leads;

Negociar propostas comerciais;

Gerenciar funil de oportunidades;

Trabalhar em parceria com SDRs;

Apresentar e demonstrar produtos e serviços.


Requisitos:

✅ Organização e comprometimento 

✅ Capacidade de vestir a camisa da empresa 

✅ Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente;

✅Tenha “fome” de resultado


O que oferecemos:

• Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com oportunidades de crescimento.

• Treinamento e desenvolvimento contínuo para aprimoramento profissional na área.

• Remuneração fixa competitiva + comissão.


Requisitos Comportamentais:

- Excelente comunicação interpessoal;

- Proatividade;

- Empatia;

- Escuta ativa;

- Atenção aos detalhes;

- Foco em qualidade.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative


Park Evaluations is a leading business immigration services firm focused on providing global corporations and law firms with the tools, guidance, and support needed to navigate a range of U.S. immigration processes and applications.


We are seeking a highly motivated and bilingual Business Development Representative to join our dynamic sales team. As a key player in our growth strategy, you will be responsible for generating qualified leads and scheduling product demos through proactive outreach and strategic engagement.


This is a fully remote position. Spoken and written proficiency in English is required for this role as you will be working with U.S.-based team members as well as English-speaking clients.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make 50–75 outbound calls daily to prospective clients across various industries.
  • Utilize CRM software to manage and execute multi-touch outreach sequences including emails, calls, and LinkedIn messages.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all prospect interactions and activities in the CRM.
  • Schedule a minimum of one product demo per day by identifying and qualifying potential customers.
  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Marketing to optimize lead generation strategies.
  • Continuously refine messaging and outreach tactics based on performance data and feedback.
  • Represent the company with professionalism and enthusiasm in all communications.


Qualifications:

  • 1–2 years of experience in a sales or business development role
  • Proficiency (spoken and written) in English.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a strong ability to craft compelling outreach messages.
  • Proven ability to deliver engaging presentations and articulate value propositions clearly.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (e.g., Zoho, Hubspot, Apollo or similar).
  • Self-starter with a strong work ethic and a passion for sales and business development.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

title: Desenvolvedor Back-End Java Sr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Software Engineer - Java

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e orientadas ao negócio;
  • Participar ativamente na elaboração das soluções;
  • Atuar em um ambiente desafiador e inspirador;
  • Colaborar com outras equipes, como UX/UI, QA e DevOps, para garantir uma entrega integrada e alinhada;


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólidos conhecimentos com a plataforma Java: Maven, Spring Framework (Spring MVC, Spring Security) e JPA
  • Bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j e ElasticSearch);
  • Observabilidade;
  • Kubernetes/Docker CD (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em temas relacionados à DevOps: CI, CD (desejável);
  • Sólida experiência com testes automatizados;
  • Javascript (ES6) e jQuery;
  • Metodologia ágil (Scrum e Kanban);

title: Sênior Gen AI Engineer - Inglês avançado/fluente
description:
Contratação PJ - valor em reais

Atuação remota

Cliente internacional - pode haver necessidade de atuar em outro fuso horário



Você é apaixonado por Inteligência Artificial Generativa e quer trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta como Langchain, RAG e LLMs? Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em GenAI e LLMs com ferramentas como Langchain e pipelines RAG.
  • Aplicar técnicas de engenharia de prompts e frameworks baseados em agentes para criar soluções inteligentes e contextuais.
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia para definir e evoluir o roadmap técnico de iniciativas com LLMs.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis e prontas para produção.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com especialistas de negócio e times de dados para garantir aderência dos modelos aos casos reais.
  • Participar de discussões de arquitetura, revisões de código e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Domínio em Python , Langchain e SQL .
  • Conhecimento profundo sobre LLMs: tuning de prompts, embeddings, bancos vetoriais e fluxos com agentes.
  • Background sólido em engenharia de software ou machine learning com visão sistêmica.
  • Experiência com AWS , Azure ou GCP .
  • Perfil colaborativo, com autonomia e excelente comunicação.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para conversação


Diferenciais:

  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência prática com LLMs e GenAI.
  • Vivência em pipelines de produtos de IA ou deploys fim a fim.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps e padrões escaláveis de deploy.
  • Experiência em projetos com clientes ou times multifuncionais de IA.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ


We’re looking for Full Stack Engineer to join our Seller team — a group of passionate, collaborative developers building seamless on-platform experiences that help us acquire and activate high-value customers. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to deliver elegant, scalable solutions that drive engagement and business growth.


What You’ll Do

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that drives company-wide initiatives.
  • Lead the product development process — from ideation and prototyping to implementation and release.
  • Architect and build scalable systems supporting millions of users.
  • Contribute to design and architectural decisions shaping the future of our software systems.
  • Rapidly prototype and run A/B tests to validate and optimize user experiences.
  • Mentor teammates, conduct code reviews, and pair-program to support shared learning.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering Management to align technical solutions with business goals.


Tech Stacks

Languages

  • Elixir
  • Erlang
  • Ruby
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript

Frameworks & Libraries

  • React
  • Next.js
  • GraphQL

Technologies & Architecture

  • Kafka
  • AWS / Lambda
  • Microservices
  • RESTful APIs
  • Event-based architecture

Databases

  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Tools & Practices

  • Git / Version control
  • IDEs
  • Continuous integration & deployment tools
  • Testing frameworks and best practices
  • CMS (Prismic)
  • A/B Testing


What You Bring

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of web application development experience with a proven track record of shipping successful products.
  • Strong background in writing reliable, maintainable code and building reusable component libraries.
  • Proficiency in at least one of the core languages or frameworks listed above.
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and remote deployment tools.

title: Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer
description:
Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer


Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join one of our key partners in building the next generation of digital commerce infrastructure. This role is focused on creating high-performance, scalable backend services that power mission-critical features for large-scale retailers and digital platforms. You will be part of a team that is shaping backend architecture, ensuring reliability under high transaction volume, and driving continuous innovation in a cloud-native environment.


Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and Python.

- Develop scalable and reliable systems capable of supporting high-traffic environments.

- Implement data validation and service architecture using frameworks such as FastAPI and Pydantic.

- Optimize and manage relational databases using PostgreSQL, ensuring performance and data integrity.

- Deploy, monitor, and scale services in Google Cloud Platform, using best practices for cloud-native development.

- Integrate backend services with Firebase for authentication, messaging, or real-time features.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and contribute to architectural decisions.

- Troubleshoot production issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement long-term solutions for system reliability.


Requirements

- 5+ years of professional experience in backend engineering with Node.js and Python.

- Strong expertise with PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization, performance tuning).

- Experience building RESTful APIs and backend services in production environments.

- Hands-on experience with FastAPI and Pydantic , or equivalent Python frameworks.

- Experience deploying and managing applications on Google Cloud Platform.

- Familiarity with Firebase services (authentication, cloud messaging, or data synchronization).


Nice to have

- Experience working with microservices or event-driven architectures.

- Knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ).

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines.

- Familiarity with observability tools and monitoring best practices.

title: Water & Sanitation Expert
description:
Join Mútua as a Short-Term Expert Reviewer for the Water & Sanitation System Transition in Latin America


Are you a researcher, consultant, or practitioner with deep expertise in the sustainability transitions of Water & Sanitation systems in Latin America?


Mútua is bringing together a select group of qualified experts for a short-term, paid engagement to collectively review the content of our intelligence platform—created to support funders seeking to accelerate the transition toward a more regenerative, equitable, and resilient water & sanitation system in the region.


About the Role


This is a temporary expert engagement, compensated on an hourly basis (with rates to be agreed upon individually). As a contributor, you will help refine and validate the knowledge embedded in our platform, ensuring it accurately reflects strategic priorities, transition pathways, and systemic leverage points relevant to water & sanitation in Latin America.


We are looking for individuals with a systems-informed perspective on:


  • Key transition pathways for equitable and sustainable water & sanitation access
  • Interventions linking water security, public health, livelihoods and climate resilience
  • The role of policy, finance, innovation, and grassroots action in driving transformation


Whether your experience is in integrated water resource management, rural and urban sanitation, water justice, climate-resilient infrastructure, or water governance—your insights will help funders better identify and support transformative initiatives.


About Mútua


Mútua is an AI-powered intelligence platform that connects mission-driven funders—from philanthropic foundations to impact investors—with innovators such as startups, NGOs, and research institutions. We align capital with systemic solutions in critical systems like food, healthcare, and energy.


By transforming fragmented impact data into actionable intelligence, we empower funders to make faster, more strategic, and more impactful decisions.


Who We’re Looking For


We invite applications from Water & Sanitation experts with:


  • Proven knowledge and experience in water & sanitation systems in Latin America
  • A strong grasp of systemic and cross-sectoral dynamics
  • The ability to provide strategic and constructive feedback on frameworks, content, and priorities


Fluency in English is required, as all content to be reviewed is written in English.


This is a remote, flexible opportunity. We welcome applicants based across the Americas and Europe.


If you're committed to shaping the future of food, agriculture, and land in Latin America—and want to contribute to a tool that mobilizes capital for systemic change—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are hiring a Graphic Designer (Remote | Full-Time)


Bring your creativity to life and make an impact on leading eCommerce brands.

We are looking for a skilled and innovative Graphic Designer with a strong eye for detail and a passion for creating engaging visuals. In this role, you will transform ideas into compelling designs that strengthen brand presence and drive results.


About the Role

You will be responsible for developing brand identities, graphic assets, and creative materials for digital marketplaces, with a strong focus on Amazon. From packaging design to 3D renders, your work will play a key role in helping brands grow and succeed online.


Responsibilities

  • Create and manage brand visuals, including logos, typography, and graphic design
  • Design assets for Amazon listings, ads, and other online platforms
  • Develop 3D renders, product packaging, website layouts, advertisements, and marketing content (manuals, eBooks, inserts, etc.)
  • Edit videos (a plus, but not required)
  • Oversee projects from concept to completion, ensuring quality and timely delivery
  • Use data insights to refine and improve creative output


Requirements

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and related tools
  • Basic knowledge of video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro is a plus)
  • Strong portfolio with eCommerce and digital design projects
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Ability to adapt quickly to new tools and processes
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week with flexibility


Why Join Us

  • Fully remote position with flexible scheduling
  • Opportunity to work on diverse projects that shape eCommerce brands
  • Career development and growth opportunities
  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment

title: Salesforce Developer / Integration Specialist (Specright & Interius)
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Developer / Integration Specialist to support and enhance integrations between Specright PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted) systems. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Salesforce integrations, API development, and Azure environments. This role focuses primarily on integration development and enhancement , not just application support.

Key Responsibilities

Integration & Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Specright , Interius , and other enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with middleware and infrastructure teams to build and test API connections , handling authentication, performance, and error scenarios.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Salesforce Dataloader scripts and data automation tools.
  • Create and maintain data flow diagrams, mappings, and technical documentation for integrations.
  • Troubleshoot integration and data synchronization issues across Salesforce and Azure environments.

Platform Configuration

  • Configure Specright workflows, templates, and user roles based on business needs.
  • Optimize platform performance and usability.
  • Support supplier onboarding , including portal access and user training.

Application & Technical Support

  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for integration and platform-related incidents.
  • Collaborate with platform vendors and internal IT teams to resolve escalated technical issues.
  • Monitor integration health and performance, identifying improvement opportunities.

Business Analysis & Collaboration

  • Partner with business users to gather and validate integration requirements .
  • Document use cases, functional and technical specifications.
  • Participate in workshops with cross-functional teams (Packaging, Procurement, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support knowledge transfer and internal team training for long-term solution sustainability.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of Specright PDMS and Salesforce architecture.
  • Proven experience with API development and integrations (REST/SOAP, JSON, XML).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure tools (Logic Apps, API Management, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Dataloader and Specright Data Loader .
  • Knowledge of authentication mechanisms such as OAuth, SSO, and token-based access.
  • Expertise in data mapping and transformation across enterprise systems.

Functional Skills

  • Strong business analysis and documentation capability.
  • Understanding of packaging data management or supplier collaboration processes .
  • Experience in regulated environments with compliance or audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication and ability to work independently in remote, cross-functional settings.

Experience Requirements

  • 5+ years in enterprise SaaS or Salesforce integration projects.
  • 2+ full implementations involving Specright or comparable Salesforce-based data systems.
  • Demonstrated success in integration and API-based development using Salesforce and Azure.

title: Network Security Specialist, Enterprise Browser
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

Your Impact

  • Win new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory
  • Achieve ACV sales quotas on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Present regular/accurate forecasting for review
  • Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
  • Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities
  • Develop, share and implement standard methodologies and account strategies to increase our sales penetration of Enterprise Browser into our top accounts
  • Engage with customers to identify and progress opportunities whilst delivering subject matter expertise on Enterprise Browser solutions
  • Qualify and progress leads and opportunities through the sales cycle to closure
  • Keep up-to-date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
  • Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
  • Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting
  • Apply subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities
  • Gather “Voice of Customer” and competitive intelligence and share with theater and global Prisma SASE organization
  • Help build and project Palo Alto Networks position
Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company
  • Sales excellence - ability to demonstrate planning, strategy, qualification and execution
  • Prior experience selling SAAS or Cybersecurity network solutions
  • Existing relationships within the region, including top accounts and reseller partners
  • Excellent communication skills including strong verbal and written skills and proven presentation skills being able to articulate complex topics
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques
Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
